correctness.rationale: The primary abstract confirms decomposition of every Boolean truss into a Boolean-ring truss and a rectangular truss and classification up to isomorphism. For a finite Boolean ring, the ring is \((\mathbb F_2)^r\) and its ring automorphisms permute the primitive idempotents, giving \(S_r\). A rectangular truss with left and right heap coordinates has multiplication \((g,h)(g',h')=(g,h')\); a heap-and-multiplication automorphism must preserve the two rectangular congruences and therefore acts by independent heap automorphisms on the coordinates. Heap automorphisms of a finite abelian group are affine, hence \(\operatorname{Hol}(G)\) and \(\operatorname{Hol}(H)\). The displayed product and order formula follow. The inspected brute-force script is only a small consistency check.
